purpose: Display table: the Russian form of every source the campaign of missions and the gate thresholds show as "Источник: ...". The canonical data keeps its English sources (it mirrors the webtypicon2 game source); only the panel shows these labels, and a missing key falls back to the original string.
convention: Scripture: Synodal book abbreviations, Psalms by the LXX (Synodal) numbering with the Hebrew number kept where the source gives it; the Fathers by their established Russian titles. A label never changes a book, chapter, verse, step or canon number and never adds an author the source does not name.
check: Entries with "check": true go to the chorus (TABOO 0.37, the patrologist) before release; "why" says what to confirm.
